project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Supabase full-stack AI marketplace
build_system: Next.js built-in (npm), uses Turbopack for dev
verification_instructions: After each feature: (1) npm run build must succeed with no errors, (2) npm run dev and manually verify the changed pages work, (3) check browser console for errors
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - no snapshot tests or generated files to commit
environment_constraints: Must work on Supabase free tier. No database exists yet - needs full schema creation. Current localStorage data must be migrated to Supabase. Must deploy to Render.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found - no specific requirements. Follow Next.js 14 App Router conventions, use TypeScript strictly, maintain Tailwind + Framer Motion UI patterns.
key_patterns: Client components use 'use client' directive. Custom hooks (useSession, useBriefs, useCreators, useProposals) wrap localStorage. API routes in app/api/. Framer Motion for all animations. Glass morphism UI with backdrop-blur. Cookie-based role storage + localStorage session. DEMO_CREDENTIALS array for demo login. Seed data from lib/seed/. Types all defined in types/index.ts.
relevant_files: app/globals.css (CSS custom properties, grain overlay, glass effect)
directory_structure: app/ contains pages (page.tsx) and API routes (api/*/route.ts). components/ has layout/ and domain folders (creators/, briefs/, ui/). hooks/ for custom React hooks. lib/ for utilities and seed data. types/index.ts for all types. middleware.ts for route protection.
